claim_scores.rationale: Defines `ImageWrapper` with `images: list[dspy.Image]` and uses it as the signature's `image` input field.
Builds a demo wrapper with three images and a query wrapper with one image, wraps the demo in `dspy.Example`, and formats via `dspy.XMLAdapter().format(...)`.
Prints and inspects `messages[1]['content']` and `messages[-1]['content']`, operating on structured content lists rather than a flattened string.
Asserts the demo user message contains exactly three `image_url` blocks via `count_image_blocks(messages[1]['content']) == 3`.
Asserts the final live-query user message contains exactly one `image_url` block via `count_image_blocks(messages[-1]['content']) == 1`.
Asserts `CUSTOM-TYPE-START-IDENTIFIER` does not appear in the formatted messages, checking sentinel text does not leak through.
